body:
I'm level 220 and I got beat on the 4th floor the two times I did a tower. But I wasn't concentrating as I was playing on the train and these were my first two runs. 

So if you use recovery items and are smart about what guardian to battle (some floors have several doors up to the next floor), you can surely do better.

author: ThisIsWhoIAm78
body:
I've gotten up to the 11th floor as a low tier 9 summoner/omnimagus. I bailed when I saw a required immortal lord with 4 immortal followers, lol.


Before that it was pretty easy though. Everything has higher health, higher attack, that sort of thing. So a berserk frost troll can still fuck you up bad and take you out if you let him get a hit in, even though he's normally a one shot kill.


Go for it, what's the worse that happens? You die? Big deal. Take the chance!

author: [deleted]
body:
Im a summonner/benefactor, and to my experience
I avoid the following if I can help it 

Immortals

Meliodas (Lyon's mark is a bitch)

Carman (carman herself isn't much of a problem it's the 5 gargoyles that come with her)

Kelpie (bring 2 Kraken's, on the lower floors it's fine but their health pool increases as with the rest of the mobs/bosses as you go up)

Ronin (brings 2 more Ronin's xD)

Mighty griffin ( 1 mighty griffin 5 normal ones, this one like the kelpie just gets harder as you go up) so I just prefer to avoid)


The rest is more or less one hit now that I have gotten the Buggane as a summon (each one does 15k~ DMG and 35k~ when crit)


Since summoner gets only guaranteed 1 summon at start ( as opposed to grand-summoner where your first equipped 2 summons will be cast automatically)


As for exiting I would absolutely recommend it if you don't think you can handle it, I had reached the last floor(titan), but had just enough shards to get summoner augria, so Instead of staying and getting rekt I left :)

Happy hunting
